A lazy table for any table or view

Source: R/data-connection.R
db_tbl.Rd

Escape hatch to any table or view in the database, as a lazy dplyr table. Nothing is read until you collect() it.

Usage

db_tbl(name, con = db_con())

Arguments

name

Table or view name, e.g. "actions", "v_speech", or "schema.table" such as "fts_main_actions.docs".

con

A DBI connection; defaults to the package connection.

Value

A lazy tbl.

Examples

db_connect(sample = TRUE)
db_tbl("sittings")
#> # A query:  ?? x 4
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.0 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2//home/runner/work/_temp/Library/ausparl/extdata/ausparl-sample.duckdb]
